d:
Former US President Barack Obama campaigned in Ohio for Democratic Senate candidate Sherrod Brown and gubernatorial candidate Amy Acton, attacking Donald Trump’s economic record and criticising Republican candidate Vivek Ramaswamy over a controversial campaign ad targeting Acton’s account of her childhood.
Obama called the election a chance to rein in the Trump administration, while Acton pushed back against the ad at the rally. With Ohio’s November 3 midterm elections approaching, the controversy adds to an increasingly heated campaign.
Watch the key moments from Obama’s Ohio rally.
